title: Predictable or Unpredictable: That is the Question!
description: Knowing how to build a process behavior chart and knowing how to interpret one is a distinction that is often overlooked. Although the skills for building process behavior charts certainly contribute to effective interpretation, the charts alone do not guarantee that insights will be turned into actions that reduce costs and improve quality.

title: How to build an XmR chart (with Excel) - Part 2
description: Building on Part 1 of this series, this essay provides additional insights into using the world's most ubiquitous analytical software to make sense of data and understand variation.

title: How to build an XmR chart (with Excel) - Part 1
description: Although the opposite is often assumed, understanding variation and making sense of data does not require special software. Excel is more than of this task.

title: The Process Principle
description: The core challenge of manufacturing is making parts that are, for all intents and purposes, the same. Yet, as hard as we try, differences in manufacturing outputs persist. The process principle provides us with an actionable framework for addressing this fundamental challenge.

title: Understanding Numerical Summaries, Part 2: Measures of Dispersion
description: An introduction to summarizing the distribution of a dataset using measures of dispersion and the role that different measures of dispersion play in the calculation of process limits.

title: Understanding Numerical Summaries, Part 1: Measures of Location
description: An introduction to finding the middle of a dataset and the role that different measures of location play in the calculation of process limits.
